_comment: Provenance for the committed WASM/JS assets in lib/assets/. Lives in tool/ (.pubignore'd) rather than lib/assets/ because it is DEVELOPMENT knowledge: consumers used to download it with the package and it told them nothing actionable. See docs/contributor/testing-runbook.md for why a git diff on the blob is uninformative.
_source_sha256_comment: sha256 over native/src/**.rs, native/Cargo.{toml,lock}, native/build.rs, js/src/**.js, js/build.js, tool/build_native_wasm.sh and tool/rust_remap.sh -- the INPUTS to the committed assets. The assets themselves are not byte-reproducible, so hashing them proves nothing; hashing what they are built from proves everything that matters. Updated by tool/prebuild.sh.
_worker_source_sha256_comment: sha256 over every file under native/worker/ (target/ excluded), native/rust-toolchain.toml, tool/build_worker_wasm.sh and tool/rust_remap.sh -- the INPUTS to lib/assets/dart_monty_core_proto_worker.wasm. Updated by tool/prebuild.sh, either scope.
